title: Architecture v3.0 Baseline Identification
summary: A source designates an April 1, 2026 architecture specification as v3.0 baseline locked and identifies it as a 12-sphere, 144-element, 110-node blueprint.
boundary: The source designation is not, by itself, a public Canon Register promotion.

title: Gravity Protocol Explicit Non-Canon Boundary
summary: The architecture source explicitly marks the Gravity Protocol as under council debate and not canonical.
boundary: Must remain non-canonical pending independently recorded review.

title: Linked Architecture Module Map
summary: The v3.0 source presents a linked module map spanning invariants, mission, mathematics, regenerative loops, agents, adoption, ontology, partner mapping, proposals, and audit.
boundary: Each linked module remains a separately reviewable source record.

title: Zero-Deletion Preservation Policy
summary: A preservation doctrine prohibits permanent removal of nodes, datasets, artifacts, and media by autonomous agents or optimization processes.
boundary: This is source-declared policy intent; operational enforcement requires code and audit evidence.

title: Full-Media Preservation Scope
summary: The preservation source names text, Markdown, audio, video, code, and raw JSON exports as covered media.
boundary: Coverage is a policy candidate, not proof that all formats are currently preserved.

title: Gap-Forensics Provenance Receipt
summary: The preservation source proposes recording a data gap as an artifact and preserving surrounding context with timestamps and metadata.
boundary: This is a provenance-event design candidate and not evidence of any particular incident.

title: Additive Signposting for Context Management
summary: The source directs context management through indexes, front doors, and lineage markers rather than destructive pruning.
boundary: Suitable for policy review; it does not establish current enforcement.

title: Agent Control-Plane Component Model
summary: A draft specification describes an agent registry, policy engine, deliberation interface, and immutable audit log as four control-plane components.
boundary: The source labels itself a draft implementation artifact; no runtime deployment is verified.

title: Signed Agent-Card Contract
summary: The draft specifies agent identifier, version, capabilities, autonomy level, constitutional hash, and public key as metadata fields.
boundary: Draft interface contract; requires implementation and security review.

title: Delegation Verification Workflow
summary: The draft proposes signed registration, constitutional-hash verification, registry publication, and signature verification before delegation.
boundary: Security design proposal; not implementation evidence.

title: Critical-Action Human Confirmation
summary: A draft UWS governance design requires direct human confirmation for critical-impact tool operations.
boundary: Candidate control; exact impact classification and confirmation implementation remain unverified.

title: Tool-Impact Registry
summary: The UWS draft describes per-tool metadata for name, description, impact level, and required permissions.
boundary: Draft data model.

title: Monitor-Only Governance Rollout
summary: The UWS draft explicitly proposes monitor-only operation before active enforcement.
boundary: Implementation sequencing proposal, not execution evidence.

title: Linked-Not-Duplicated 12×12 Taxonomy
summary: A living master index organizes material into 12 folders by 12 subsets and describes cross-domain artifacts as links rather than duplicates.
boundary: Navigation/taxonomy model; individual records still need review.

title: Artifact Tiering Backlog
summary: The master index lists Tier 1/2/3 assignment for every artifact as unfinished work.
boundary: A declared backlog item, not a completed classification system.

title: Live Atlas Lattice v5 Public Landing Page
summary: The canonical v5 public address rendered a non-empty Aluminum OS and New Deal 2.0 landing page during recovery review.
boundary: Public-page availability is directly observed; all architectural, economic, and deployment statements on the page remain source claims.

title: V5 Governance Route Map
summary: The v5 landing page exposes route references for canon, invariants, doctrines, sovereign-dividend material, and a governance failure ledger.
boundary: Each referenced route is independently reviewable and does not inherit canon status merely by linkage.

title: V5 Canon Draft Boundary
summary: The v5 public canon route identifies its state as a v4.1 draft with ratification in progress and includes open items.
boundary: The route’s self-declared authority does not supersede the separate public GitHub Canon Register or Alexandria’s allowlist.

title: V5 Status-Aware Invariant Registry
summary: The public invariant route visibly distinguishes ratified and proposed entries within a 60-record registry.
boundary: Statuses are site-declared and require reconciliation before canonical ingestion; embedded financial or deployment claims are not independently verified.

title: V5 Status-Aware Doctrine Registry
summary: The public doctrine route presents a registry of 120 entries with ratified, under-discussion, and proposed labels.
boundary: Provider-named and role-specific records require quarantine review under the active corpus policy.

title: V5 Governance Failure-Ledger Source
summary: The public failure-ledger route preserves process-control definitions, mitigations, and source-attribution requirements.
boundary: Historical descriptions remain source text; they cannot establish unverified misconduct or attribution involving named people, organizations, or providers.

title: Regenerative AI Governance Principle
summary: The preserved legacy document articulates a governance principle centered on creator agency, attribution, environmental responsibility, and reviewable AI decision-making.
boundary: Conceptual compatibility only; operational controls and performance claims require independently reviewed evidence.

title: Functional Mirror Council Interface
summary: The legacy document proposes separation among causal reasoning, strategy, narrative, risk, and execution functions; the durable candidate is a substrate-neutral role interface.
boundary: Named vendor or model assignments are excluded; functional roles require individual authority and evidence definitions.

title: Pendragon Provenance Event Protocol Lineage
summary: The legacy document identifies a provenance-event pattern for attribution and review; Alexandria now implements a named Pendragon append-only protocol without inheriting payment or deployment assertions.
boundary: The legacy source establishes design lineage only; Alexandria implementation and payment/compensation claims are separately reviewable.

title: Creator Attribution and Compensation Research Track
summary: The legacy source proposes creator attribution, licensing, and compensation as a research direction for a future rights-aware ecosystem.
boundary: No payment, revenue, ownership, licensing, or legal compliance claim is established by this candidate.

title: Environmental Impact Evidence Model
summary: The legacy source proposes environmental accountability and circular reinvestment as a measurement-oriented research direction.
boundary: The proposal provides no validated metrics, units, methods, or external source references for operational impact claims.

title: Lattice Shape Declaration
summary: The locked architecture source describes a 12-sphere, 144-element, 110-node blueprint.
boundary: This is a source-declared model shape and does not independently verify implementation completeness.

title: Architecture v3 Revision Provenance
summary: The v3.0 source records a revision history that removed selected framing, qualified financial-ramp material, documented debate status, and established signatory authority.
boundary: Historical revision description only; the underlying changes and authority require separate review evidence.

title: Autonomy Policy-Level Model
summary: A draft control-plane specification distinguishes advisory, collaborative, and autonomous action levels with human or council escalation according to level.
boundary: Draft policy model; it does not establish deployed enforcement or a complete impact taxonomy.

title: Immutable Audit-Log Intent
summary: The draft proposes an immutable ledger for actions, policy evaluations, and council decisions.
boundary: Design intent only; runtime immutability and coverage are unverified pending implementation evidence.

title: Read-Only Audit-Freeze Proposal
summary: The preservation doctrine proposes a read-only freeze across connected records during an audit, recording scope, duration, trigger, and release.
boundary: High-impact design proposal requiring human authorization, proportionality, and implementation evidence.

title: MCP Middleware Gate Proposal
summary: The UWS governance draft proposes intercepting incoming MCP tool calls before execution with approve, deny, or escalate outcomes.
boundary: Draft architecture only; enforcement behavior and exception handling require implementation and security review.

title: Least-Privilege Execution Proposal
summary: The UWS governance draft proposes executing requests under the originating user identity and permission scope.
boundary: Intended security control; identity propagation and permission enforcement require runtime evidence.

title: Twelve-Domain Filing Structure
summary: The living master index names a twelve-domain filing structure spanning constitutional, governance, diplomacy, intellectual-property, life-system, care, verification, cultural, infrastructure, archive, public-release, and checkpoint material.
boundary: Historical source taxonomy only; individual records and classifications require independent review.

title: Cross-Domain Reference Edges
summary: The master index describes certain artifacts as linked across folders rather than duplicated, supporting candidate relationship edges in a graph model.
boundary: Candidate relationship pattern only; source-level edge reconciliation is required before graph assertion.
